NONE: › a thick, clear, liquid substance, especially one used on the hair or body
（尤指用於洗髮或護膚的）凝膠，凍膠

I: › [ I ] US also jell to change from a liquid into a thick, soft solid
› [ I ] US also jell If an idea or situation gels, it starts to become more clear and fixed.
（想法或局勢）變得更清楚，顯得更明確
› [ I ] US also jell If two or more people gel, they form a good relationship or become friends.
形成親密關係；結成好友

T: › [ T ] to put gel on your hair

example: They talked a lot about opening a restaurant, but their plans never gelled.
他們總是說要開一個餐館，可是從來沒有付諸實踐過。
The team really gelled during the first few games of the season.
在這個賽季頭幾場比賽中，球隊表現得很有凝聚力，配合十分默契。
He had spiky, light brown hair, shaved at the sides and gelled on top.
他淺褐色的頭髮一簇簇地直立著，剃去兩鬢，頭頂上打了髮膠。

NONE: › a clear substance made from animal bones and used especially to make jelly

example: The liquid solidifies into a gelatinous mass.
這種液體凝結成一種膠狀物。

NONE: › to remove the testicles of a male horse or similar animal
閹割（馬等動物），給（馬等）去勢
› a male horse that has been gelded
› a very powerful explosive substance, similar to dynamite
葛裡炸藥（一種烈性炸藥）
